title: H3 / FastH3 L4 speed evidence

scope.gpu: single NVIDIA L4, sm_89, 24 GB VRAM

answer: The source-supported low-latency candidate for L4 is the already selected FastH3 4-forward student schedule plus 64-token/90% VSA, with an SM89-capable attention path. FastVideo's published SM89 measurements are RTX 4090, not L4. FastH3 V2 is a separate 8-forward T2VA student; ComfyUI also exposes an I2VA interface, although FL2VA was not distilled and was not distilled for Ref2VA.

local_baseline.shape: 864x480, 124 generated frames, 120-frame/5.000 s trim, 4 Euler steps, 200 native VSA calls
local_baseline.caveat: The steady four-step and warm total are estimates; no true warm 5-second total was measured.

limits: quality below base, especially high-motion detail
FL2VA and Ref2VA were not distilled
findings.l4_status: not a substitute for the current 1300-step 4-step checkpoint

findings.reported_data: RTX 4090 warm 5-second clips: 54.6/43.9 s at 832x480 and 154.6/132.8 s at 1344x768 for V2/Trim
findings.l4_status: SM89 taxonomy matches L4, but L4 timing/quality/fallback is unverified

findings.reported_data: H3 T=80k: 23.4 to 13.0 s/it vs dense INT8; cosine about 0.97 vs dense; below 12k tokens dense usually faster
findings.l4_status: benchmark tuned on SM120; no L4 end-to-end result

explicit: W4A8 about 0.56 B/element and about 1.09x INT8 speed
lazy load reduces peak to largest overlap but reloads next request
exact text cache requires identical prompt/reference/options
reported_data: third-party NVFP4/AWQ text encoder: 67 s uncached, 12.5 s warm weight cache, 0.2 s output hit
text output cache about 12 MB per 768x1344 scene
limits: no official L4 H3 text-cache benchmark
findings.l4_status: cold/warm, pin/unpin and cache hit/miss require local measurement

findings.source: MiniMax official H3 README and Comfy official docs
explicit: FastH3 8-step model card is T2VA-only; ComfyUI exposes first/last-frame inputs outside the distilled scope
Ref2VA uses a different base checkpoint
findings.l4_status: semantic boundary, not a speed claim

measurement_contract.source_statement: two fixed prompts, one excluded warmup, two timed generate_video wall-time runs each

search_boundary: No L4 source reported true cold/warm 5-second FastH3 total.
No official FastVideo/Comfy core prompt-conditioning cache with L4 benchmark was found.
OmniRef PDD-8 Blackwell-only / about 103 GiB peak was excluded as an L4 recipe.
External source timings were kept separate from local L4 measurements and no TFLOPS-to-time inference was made.

primary_review.training_scope_correction: Distinguish interface availability from model-card distilled scope
primary_review.source: Official FastVideo 8-Step V2 model card and Comfy docs already independently read
